packageRules.description: compose-multiplatform: pin to the 1.11.x line. Compose 1.12 changes the CanvasLayersComposeScene API used by the UI builder's structured-SVG recorder, while the standalone distribution's renderer-desktop and daemon-desktop sidecars remain governed by the deliberately held compose-ai-tools host floor. Moving to 1.12 therefore requires a coordinated source migration, full visual verification, and any intended host-floor release rather than an automated dependency bump.
The design-parity packages are published in lockstep from one monorepo, so update them together in a single PR.
